mktFeatures.subtitle: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and your website chat in one shared inbox, with AI agents, flows, broadcasts, sales and bookings. No code.

inbox.name: Multichannel shared inbox
inbox.desc: Handle WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and your website chat in one place. Assign conversations to your team, leave internal notes and mention a teammate.

agents.name: AI agents
agents.desc: Agents that know your business: hours, services, products and FAQs. They answer, take orders and book appointments, and hand the chat to a person when needed. They use AI tokens.

faq.name: FAQ bot
faq.desc: Free with numbered menus («1. Hours, 2. Prices…»): the customer picks and gets the answer instantly, with no tokens used. If you want it to understand open questions, your AI agent answers.

flows.name: No-code flows
flows.desc: Build step-by-step conversations with messages, buttons, lists and numbered menus. They start on a keyword or on the customer's first message.

automations.name: Automations and follow-ups
automations.desc: Sequences with waits, conditions and tags: remind an appointment, win back an inactive customer or follow up on a quote without lifting a finger.

broadcasts.name: Template broadcasts
broadcasts.desc: Create WhatsApp templates with a preview, submit them to Meta for approval from Whasalia, and send them to contacts filtered by tags.

crm.name: Contacts and sales pipelines
crm.desc: Tag and filter your contacts, and move each opportunity through the stages of your pipeline on a board.

commerce.name: Catalog, orders and bookings
commerce.desc: Upload your products and services, take orders by chat and let customers book your team's free slots.

integrations.name: Integrations and API
integrations.desc: Google Calendar for appointments, MercadoLibre and real-estate portals, and a REST API with webhooks to connect n8n, Make, Zapier or your own system.

tasks.name: Tasks
tasks.desc: Create and assign tasks linked to your contacts and conversations so nothing slips.

reports.name: Reports
reports.desc: First response time, volume by channel and agent, conversion from conversations to orders, and each broadcast's status: sent, delivered, read and failed.

rbac.name: Roles for your team
rbac.desc: Owner, admin and agent: each person sees and changes only what they should.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Getting started with Whasalia takes minutes.
how.s1Desc: Connect WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger with your Facebook account in a few clicks, and add the chat to your website by pasting a snippet.
how.s2Desc: Load your hours, services and FAQs. Choose whether a free menu, an AI agent or your team answers.
how.s3Desc: See in the reports how fast you answer, which channel brings the most conversations and how many end in an order.

meta.title: Built on Meta's official APIs
meta.eyebrow: WhatsApp Business Platform, Instagram and Messenger
meta.desc: Whasalia only uses Meta's official APIs. No unofficial apps or shortcuts that put your number at risk: your account follows WhatsApp Business policies.
meta.i1Desc: Your number connects straight to Meta. Register a new one or keep using the one in your WhatsApp Business app (coexistence).
meta.i2Desc: Customers who come from your Facebook and Instagram ads get an instant answer from your menu, your flow or your AI agent.
meta.i3Desc: Create templates with a preview and named variables, submit them for review and follow their status without leaving Whasalia.
meta.i4Desc: See whether each message and broadcast was sent, delivered, read or failed, with the reason Meta reports.
meta.footerBadge: Uses the official WhatsApp Business API

mktPricing.subtitle: Use the whole platform with no monthly fee. If you turn on AI agents, top up tokens when you need them.

mktIntegrations.subtitle: No complicated migration. Connect your ecommerce platform, developer webhooks, or CRM in minutes.

shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.desc: Sync cart dropouts, trigger WhatsApp payment reminders, and dispatch shipment templates automatically.

hubspot.name: HubSpot
hubspot.desc: Automatically push qualified WhatsApp chats, tags, and meeting booking events into HubSpot contact timelines.

zapier.name: Zapier
zapier.desc: Connect WhatsApp API events to over 5,000 apps. Trigger workflows based on incoming user messages.

webhooks.name: Developer Webhooks
webhooks.desc: Subscribe to live JSON payloads for delivered texts, template read confirmations, and incoming chat threads.

salesforce.name: Salesforce
salesforce.desc: Enterprise-grade contact synchronizations. Route high-value leads directly to dedicated account executives.

slack.name: Slack Notifications
slack.desc: Post channel notifications when high-intent enterprise leads reply or complete calendar schedulers.

mktAiAutomation.subtitle: Stop waiting for agents to type response messages. Deploy an autonomous intelligence layer directly on WhatsApp. Qualify lead budgets, identify needs, answering product catalog queries instantly.

playground.title: Tailor Your AI Prompts.
playground.desc: Select standard models or plug in custom fine-tuned parameters. Set instructions, intent rules, and custom data context dynamically.

prompts.gpt4: You are a friendly customer concierge for Acme Corp. Assess if the user's monthly message volume exceeds 10,000, and if so, tag as 'High Value' and request their email address to route to Sarah.
prompts.claude3: Identify if the customer is expressing interest in an enterprise SLA or regional database hosting. Tag appropriately and suggest booking a sales meeting.
prompts.custom: Analyze lead chat response. Tag 'Support Request' if seeking help, otherwise query their target CRM budget.

benefits.calendarDesc: Let the AI agent schedule meetings automatically. Sync with calendars and trigger confirmation messages instantly.
benefits.vectorDesc: Sync your FAQs, product catalogs, and help center articles to vector stores so the agent always stays on-brand.
benefits.handoffDesc: Agent seamlessly stops auto-replies when a human rep intervenes. Set triggers for instant human assistance alerts.

plan.tagline: The whole platform, no monthly fee.
plan.note: No card and no trial period.

features.channels: Shared inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and web chat
features.crm: Contacts, sales pipelines, tags and tasks
features.automations: Flows, automations and broadcasts with Meta-approved templates
features.agents: AI agents trained on your business (they use AI tokens)
features.team: Your team with roles and permissions
features.api: API and webhooks to connect your systems

tokens.name: AI tokens
tokens.tagline: You only pay for the AI you use.
tokens.equivalence: 1 token = 1 reply from your AI agent.
tokens.welcome: {n} free tokens when you create your account
tokens.minimum: Minimum top-up: {min}. You can also top up another amount.
tokens.payment: Pay by card, Yape, Plin or bank transfer.

costs.title: What uses tokens?
costs.subtitle: Only AI actions. Everything else is free.
costs.free: If you run out of tokens, your AI agents pause and messages go to the inbox for your team to answer. Nothing else stops.

mktPlans.metaFees: WhatsApp template messages are charged by Meta directly to your WhatsApp Business account, at its official rates. Whasalia adds no markup.
